title: PH60102: Physics Of Surfaces And Interfaces
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Surface structures, relaxations and reconstructions; Adsorption, desorption and
diffusion; two-dimensional reciprocal lattice and crystal truncation rods;
Physics of ultra-high vacuum (UHV); Reciprocal space mapping - Grazing angle Xray diffraction (GAXRD), Electron diffraction, X-ray reflectivity (XRR), X-ray
standing wave (XSW) analysis; Ion scattering techniques - Particle induced Xray emission (PIXE) and Secondary ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS); Surface
magnetism; X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD).
